response.sql:
WITH execution_counts AS (
    SELECT ordersmark, COUNT(*) AS execution_count
    FROM orderexecutions
    GROUP BY ordersmark
),
shares AS (
    SELECT ordersmark, execution_count,
           CAST(execution_count AS REAL) / SUM(execution_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM execution_counts
),
scored AS (
    SELECT ordersmark, execution_count, share,
           share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_minus_average
    FROM shares
)
SELECT ordersmark, execution_count, share, share_minus_average
FROM scored
ORDER BY share_minus_average DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The single group of executions with a missing ordersmark is represented by SQL NULL; SQLite groups those rows together. Shares and the average share are calculated over all distinct order-reference groups, including that NULL group, with each group weighted equally in the average.
